_comment: Everything is in the PLAN FRAME: re-zeroed via /mpc_reset_origin, so (0,0)/yaw=0 means 'wherever Spot was standing, facing whatever direction, at the moment you last pressed Reset Origin'. No bridge/wall geometry here -- that was only ever a simulation proxy and this node's scoring never reads it. What actually matters, per cluster pair 'start-next': bearing_map's angle (radians, plan-frame -- this is the PRIMARY steering signal and should be the most reliable number you have, e.g. from a known map/topology), and centroids' rough (forward, left) location in metres for each cluster (used for Voronoi cluster-identity classification and a soft directional nudge -- fine if only approximately known).
